verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Version History feature for accessing and previewing all saved versions, tracking changes, recovering earlier file states, and manually saving new versions; the pricing page lists file version history as a plan feature. That covers restore and manual checkpoints, but naming milestones and comparing versions are not documented: preview is not a side-by-side comparison. missing for 10: explicit milestone naming, version compare/diff, independent or hands-on corroboration.
